Packaging claim: Dishwashers Time When They Release Detergent
Core fact: On common Bosch programs, the detergent dispenser opens automatically at an optimum point in the selected program rather than simply dumping the tablet at the instant Start is pressed.
Second reveal: That timing is why blocking the dispenser or tablet-catching area can stop detergent from dissolving correctly.
First-frame and mechanism proof: Close a dishwasher detergent compartment, press Start, then show the compartment opening later in the cycle.
